evidence_class_detail: self-contained exact historical loop replay on pinned public data; not execution of the complete historical GR00T API or stack

execution.backend_compatibility: The default PyAVHistoricalReader is an explicit E2 compatibility substitution because torchvision 0.26 removed VideoReader. It preserves the historical keyframe-backward seek and selection loops but is not the complete historical software stack.

historical_replay.fixed: seek(first); load until current>=last; for each target return latest loaded PTS<=target, else first
historical_replay.old: seek(first); load until current>=last or loaded_count>=request_count; return loaded order

execution.local_frame_interval_rule: minimum positive gap to an adjacent distinct source PTS
execution.oracle: independent full sequential PyAV decode with exact PTS and RGB-byte SHA-256

queries.duplicate_pts_equivalence: all frames at the selected PTS are equivalent
queries.negative_control: every decoded source PTS in original order
queries.oracle_selection: latest source PTS <= target; first frame if none

time_semantics.cross_group_duplicate_targets: retain and count separately by query-group ID
time_semantics.duplicate_pts_equivalence: set of RGB SHA-256 digests at selected PTS
time_semantics.duration_span: last decoded PTS seconds - first decoded PTS seconds

limitations: E2 replays the exact parent and PR #373 selection loops but does not execute the complete historical GR00T stack.
The ten videos are the manifest's mechanically selected official inputs; no failed, null, or inconvenient input is replaced.
RGB digests require the pinned PyAV/torchvision decode environment recorded above; an incompatible decoder is a reported failure, not a reason to weaken matching.
The top-level natural unit is a video; timestamp-query aggregates are descriptive within-video diagnostics.
